chapter_outcomes: Recall and use Newton's second law as: force (newton, N) = mass (kilogram, kg) × acceleration (metre per second squared, m/s²), F = m × a

Core Practical 2.19: Investigate the relationship between force, mass and acceleration by varying the masses added to trolleys - use different masses to investigate effect on acceleration down a ramp, measure force and time, calculate acceleration
Recall and use the equation: acceleration (metre per second squared, m/s²) = change in velocity (metre per second, m/s) ÷ time taken (second, s), a = (v - u)/t
